name: Formula field | Missing compared with Zoho: date, text and math functions, return type choice, formulas using formulas, email merge fields
description_html:
Summary

Formula fields in TAVI CRM and Desk (layout builder › Formula) compared with Zoho CRM formula fields. TAVI has 17 functions (if, concat, coalesce, min, max, sum, avg, count, upper, lower, trim, len, abs, round, isblank, number, text) and string/number/boolean/date results. These are the capabilities Zoho offers that TAVI does not. Bugs found in the same run are filed separately (NDC-3216..NDC-3228).

Missing items

#

Priority

Item

Zoho

TAVI now

Cases

G1

High

Date and time functions

Now(), Today(), Newdate(), Adddate(), Subdate(), Datecomp(), Datepart(), Timepart(), Year(), Month(), Dayofmonth(), Weekday(), Hour(), Minute()

None. "Unknown function 'today'" (also now, adddate, datecomp, year). A date result type exists but nothing can work out a date (age in days, due date + 3 days).

Z1, Z9, D22

G2

High

Choose the result type in the builder

The admin picks the return type first: Number/Currency/Decimal/Percent, String, Date, DateTime, Boolean, with decimal places

The layout builder has no return-type control and saves none. The API takes string, number, boolean, date only (no currency, percent, decimal places, date-time).

Z2, Z12, B1, B8

G3

High

A formula can use another formula (and rollups)

Formula fields can be used inside other formulas

Refused: DATATYPE_FORMULA_CHAIN_UNSUPPORTED "A formula cannot read another computed field" — also for rollup summary fields. The "Insert a field" list hides them. (Subform formula columns can chain; parent formulas cannot.)

Z8, E28, E29

G4

Medium

Text functions

Find(), Contains(), Startswith(), Endswith(), Substring(), Replace(), Tostring()

Only upper, lower, trim, len, concat, text. The rest are "Unknown function".

Z3

G5

Medium

Math functions

Ceil(), Floor(), Sqrt(), Mod(), Naturallog(), Base10log()

Only abs, round, min, max, sum, avg (% operator works for remainder).

Z4

G6

Low

Logic functions

And(), Or(), Not(), Case()

and / or / not exist as operators; And(), Or(), Not() and Case() functions are refused. Case() has no replacement except nested if().

Z5

G7

Low

Expression length

Up to 5,000 characters

2,000 characters (also 512 tokens, 32 levels of nesting).

Z6, G11

G8

Low

Blank handling option

Choose whether blank fields count as 0 / empty

No option. Numbers count blank as 0 (E7), avg skips blanks, min counts 0 (NDC-3225).

Z7

G9

Low

Auto-refreshing formulas

Up to 2 formulas per module that use Now() are recalculated over time, with a stop condition

Not available (no Now()); formulas are only worked out when a record is saved (see NDC-3219).

Z9

G10

Medium

Record fields in email templates

Templates and mails can use the record's fields (merge fields), including formula fields

Mail templates accept only {{recipient_email}}, {{recipient_name}}, {{sender_email}}, {{sender_name}}, {{today}}; any other placeholder is refused (MAIL_TEMPLATE_UNKNOWN_PLACEHOLDER). Not formula-specific.

I9

Not gaps

  • Live syntax checking in the editor instead of a "Check Syntax" button — fine (Z10).

  • A board cannot be grouped by a formula (pick list / status / radio only) — same in Zoho.

  • Text comparison is case-insensitive ("ABC" = "abc" is true) — differs from Zoho (case-sensitive); listed for a product decision, not as a gap.

Environment

  • TAVI CRM and Desk web, staging-crm / staging-desk.taviportal.com, org NDC-Staging, owner; checked 23 Nov 2026 (API + layout builder).

  • Zoho side: Zoho CRM help pages (create formula fields, formula functions), docs/crm-go-live-feature-inventory/reference/zoho-crm-inventory.md.

Evidence

  • Test plan docs/formula-fields (Group Z); results executions/execu_2026-11-23_formula-fields (PROGRESS.md, report.html).
